findings.project_classification: Monorepo with one primary Electron desktop application and internal workspace libraries for UI, AI core, provider registry, tracing, editor extensions, and vector storage

findings.existing_docs: Large pre-existing documentation surface in docs/ plus multiple local README files under src/, packages/, tests/, migrations/, and v2-refactor-temp/
